reliability.READY: executed successfully with non-error SQL and validated artifact present; zero rows allowed only with SUCCESS_ZERO + documented limitations
reliability.PARTIAL: partial evidence produced with explicit errors list non-empty OR incomplete product set
reliability.NOT_READY: missing required inputs/tables/data for product; artifact may exist as empty with reason

zero_records: SUCCESS_ZERO or NOT_READY with limitations; never invent GO/rows
partial_error: fail-closed: non-zero exit; errors surface in manifest; never convert SQL/_error/rollback into trustworthy empty CSV success
